errors.text: Introducing a eutectic microstructure without specifying a compositional change is not a well-defined single intervention and would not intrinsically reduce the alloy's theoretical density.
The hypothesis omits the key intervention of adding 4.2 at.% Cr and the resulting approximately 4 vol.% interconnected Cr-rich Laves phase.

No cited evidence demonstrates that a eutectic HfMoTaTiZr variant retains mechanical properties near 1000 °C; the cited eutectic-alloy evidence concerns a different alloy system and only extends to 700 °C.
